unstuck_said.text: First contact via grounded comment on issue #17 (pre-trade token safety check for spending mandates): the check exists because a mandate can authorize swapping an unknown token (honeypot/tax/liquidity). On Nano the mandate asset is the native XNO - no token contract, no honeypot/tax/liquidity, nothing to rug; the block enforces the mandate, so the pre-trade check is structurally unnecessary. Offered to draft an additive nano:mainnet exact scheme leaving Robinhood Chain untouched.
